source: Data.gov.sg / IRAS, "Tax Rates for Individual Income Tax" (open dataset, resource_id d_f73055c69144d2e7734c28811d3982aa). Government open-data record of every Singapore resident individual income tax rate schedule and the Year of Assessment each took effect, YA2003-2024.
units: SGD chargeable income; rate as a fraction
note: Each entry's 'brackets' has the same shape as data/tax_brackets_ya2026.json: [upper bound of band, rate on income within that band], null upper bound = no limit. 'year_of_assessment' is the first YA the schedule applied; 'effective_through' is the last YA before the next schedule in this list took over (null = still current, matches tax_brackets_ya2026.json). Confidence: primary/official (government open-data portal attributing IRAS as the source agency), not a secondary/forum source, so no [VERIFY] tag. The 2003 and 2006 entries are the tail of a multi-year phased rate cut that settled at the 2007 schedule (every band fell a little each year); 2007, 2012, 2017 and 2024 are the genuine structural revisions used for calibration in srs_tax_regime.py — see that file's docstring.
